text: Parks, Forestry and Recreation staff will give a presentation on the Toronto Island Master Plan, including highlights of short- and long-term investments in Toronto Island, improvements to Visitor Experience, and updates on ongoing opportunities for continued engagement with stakeholders and community members including Queer, Indigenous, Black, and equity-deserving communities, racialized populations, and low-income communities.
The Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee received the item for information.
